verdict.rationale: The official README explicitly lists "AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures", which names every instruction set in the story. A community report of running 30B–70B models on a 4-core i7 desktop CPU confirms practical x86 CPU inference, though it does not mention the instruction sets. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how these instruction-set paths are enabled or selected (build or runtime), and independent benchmarks showing the speedup from AVX512/AMX specifically.
